title: Turkish-Style Stuffed Butternut Squash
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that combines the sweetness of butternut squash with the spices of Turkish cuisine.
instructions: Cut the butternut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds.
Place the squash cut-side up on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
While the squash is roasting, heat some oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kofte and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the squash from the oven and fill each half with the kofte mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Return the squash to the oven and roast for another 15-20 minutes, or until the flesh is tender.
